verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a data platform (not itself an agent), so this axis applies, and Jitsu documents a first-party MCP server at use.jitsu.com/mcp that lets AI agents create destinations, wire streams, inspect Live Events, and edit Functions, with OAuth 2.1 for interactive clients and API-key auth for headless/CI use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented beyond Jitsu's own docs/blog.
